page_title: AI Meme Video Generator from Photos | RemixMeme

sources.entry: RemixMeme - AI meme video generator from photos with dance, pet and funny templates. #paid

summary.name: RemixMeme
summary.one_liner: RemixMeme is a web tool that turns one or two adult face photos into short, watermark-free 9:16 AI meme videos using a library of 488 viral-style templates.
use_cases: Make a dance video from a single photo for TikTok
Turn a pet photo into a funny viral meme clip
Create a Reels-ready vertical video of yourself in a trending meme
Produce a group duet or trio dance clip from two photos
Make a seasonal Christmas or holiday AI photo video
summary.what_it_does: Users pick a meme template, upload 1 to 2 clear photos of adults (JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 9 MB each), and get an AI-generated MP4 of about 15 seconds in 9:16 format. The site says exports are watermark-free and that the trending sound must be added separately in TikTok or Reels, since commercial trend songs are not included. Templates are browsable without an account and are grouped by category and sorted by newest date. Video generation uses credits, with a 720p Ready for TikTok/Reels export costing 500 credits and a draft costing 375. Photos are deleted after rendering, and the site states they are sent to a third-party AI video provider.
notable: 488 meme templates including dance, pet and funny categories, with watermark-free MP4 exports
Subscriptions and one-time credit packs; browsing templates is free but video needs credits
Requires photos of adults only, with consent and a label for AI content when posting
caveats: Video generation requires paid credits or a subscription; free welcome credits only cover images
Trend songs are not included and must be added manually in TikTok or Reels
Only adults (18+) with rights or consent may be photographed; children, strangers and non-consensual deepfakes are prohibited
